prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a production-ready square 2048 x 2048 diffuse/base-color surface atlas for a low-poly 3D Snow White Seven Dwarves missile turret and physical missiles from Goddess of Victory NIKKE.
Create a FLAT 2D TEXTURE SHEET, NOT a render of a turret or any object. Four perfectly equal square surface swatches in a precise 2 by 2 grid, each quadrant touching its neighbors with NO gaps, NO outer margins, NO grid lines, NO labels or captions. Every quadrant fills exactly 50 percent width and height.
TOP LEFT quadrant: cool ivory-white painted military armor, large mostly quiet pale panels, restrained thin charcoal panel seams near perimeter, fine tiny recessed screws, subtle hand-painted edge wear exposing bluish gray alloy. Main interior remains at least 80 percent pale ivory. No large black areas, stripes, numbers, logos, or broad dirt.
TOP RIGHT quadrant: very dark charcoal gunmetal mechanism casing, subtle broad flat layered metal plates, small inset service-panel seams, narrow milled grooves, little vents near the edges, tiny cold gray abrasion and subdued bolts. Main interior is dark neutral slate. No gold trim and no emissive lights.
BOTTOM LEFT quadrant: cool ivory-white shield armor with sparse military details: one small dark gray stencil "01" in the upper left, one tiny outlined warning triangle in the lower right, two short thin graphite panel seams, one small muted ochre rectangular safety tab near the bottom edge, slight chipped edges. Mostly empty white armor. No other readable writing.
BOTTOM RIGHT quadrant: ivory-white rocket casing wrap, uniform off-white middle area, a narrow muted mustard-yellow horizontal identification band near the lower third, two very fine dark gray horizontal circumference seams, one tiny black maintenance stencil "SD". Flat unwrapped surface only, no missile silhouette, no fins, no nose drawing. Keep the broad center light.
Visual direction: match the original NIKKE Snow White equipment's white angular shields, matte graphite mechanisms and restrained yellow hazard accents. Clean anime hard-surface game painting, crisp graphic detail that reads when small, light edge scuffs, subtle painted bevels. Flat even albedo lighting without environmental highlights or shadows. Orthographic surface swatches viewed perfectly straight on. No perspective, no 3D extrusion, no drop shadows, no background scene, no decorative frame, no reference board, no transparency. No cyan or blue glowing energy. Exact quadrant arrangement is essential because geometry UVs sample these four squares.
